## Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Motivation & Problem
What problem does this solve? Why is this useful for safe filesystem cleanup?

## Alignment with Filesystem Safety Invariants
Please review Reclaim's 10 Safety Invariants before proposing mutations:
- Does this feature involve filesystem mutations?
- Can it be performed atomically without replacing existing files?
- Is it conditional and reversible?

## Proposed Implementation / UX
How should this look in the Desktop UI or CLI?
